title: Pantry Measurement Mystery Paper Tab Inference Card
inferenceSkill: Use one clue, what it might suggest, why, a second clue, an inference sentence, and a paper tab check for a fictional pantry measurement mystery: ____________________.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only inference card for an invented pantry measurement story with pretend scoops, marks, and labels: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: place this card, a pencil, and two blank paper tabs beside a pretend pantry counter sketch: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a careful pantry helper who notices measurement clues and writes only made-up story details: ____________________.
cluePrompt: clue: Write one pretend measurement clue, such as a shifted scoop, uneven cup mark, or folded label edge: ____________________.
suggestsPrompt: might suggest: What might this clue suggest about the helper's next story move: ____________________.
whyPrompt: why: Explain why the clue might suggest that idea inside the pretend pantry mystery: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: second clue: Add a different pantry clue that points toward the same inference without repeating the first clue: ____________________.
inferenceSentencePrompt: inference sentence: Write one sentence that uses both clues to tell what the helper can infer: ____________________.
paperTabCheckPrompt: paper tab check: Mark the paper tab when the inference sentence uses clue, might suggest, why, and second clue language: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Fill only the clue and might suggest blanks first, then add why later: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this paper card and add one new pretend pantry clue with an adult later: ____________________.
